claims.text: The dataset consists of transcripts of all debates held by IQ2 in the US from September 2006 to September 2015, totaling 108 debates.
Each debate in the dataset has an average of 12801 words and 117 turns by members of either side.
The dataset allows for analysis of conversational dynamics and includes rich metadata.
